digest_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON: sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon)
mechanism_contract_digest: source_contract_sha256 remains legacy.digest(mechanism); checked for atomic match and excluded from evidence snapshot payload
viewports_payload: Ordered selected scene records plus the explicitly linked parent snapshot and canonical archive identity for each scene
snapshot_bindings: Exact object mapping each independent_evidence_unit_id to its re-derived evidence_snapshot_sha256; no sorted anonymous digest list
citation_digest: Digest of the entire canonical attribution evidence source record; changes require a new explicit review
optional_metadata: Only source fields actually present are copied. Missing historic snapshot_id is not fabricated; an unambiguous registered parent screenshot/hash/archive tuple is used where it is the existing identity.
legacy_policy: Contract-only flags, missing subjects/citations/reviewer, stale digests and wrong mappings are UNKNOWN. Known shared/duplicate families remain NOT_INDEPENDENT. No ledger regeneration writes or upgrades stored reviews.
semantic_boundary: Hash/record binding validates the reviewed subject and citation identity, not the truth of a URL or reviewer statement; formal semantic review remains necessary
canonical_family_denials: Known shared family IDs and derivative discovery classes are read from registered unit records as well as conservative caller denials; a caller cannot hide them by omitting/changing its copy.
